dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: This reminds me of the kind of places Lyney takes me to do street magic.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: With a parasol for comfort — and without Lyney's constant chatter — I estimate my energy recharge rate will double.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: I'm gonna sit here and drink some tea for a while. Wanna join me? I remember how much sugar you take in yours.
